bn_fixture: deterministic non-default affine parameters and running buffers: weight=0.5+uniform, bias=0.1*normal, mean=0.2*normal, variance=0.5+uniform, num_batches_tracked=[7,11]
state_mapping_policy: semantic roles from runtime module call order plus reviewed source; no fixed candidate class/attribute names or AST sentences; fail on ambiguity or incomplete coverage
strict_format_policy: original runner JSON acceptance remains authoritative; if only an exact outer Markdown fence blocks parsing, preserve failure and create a reversible derived extraction for downstream diagnostics without changing code
code_execution_policy: inspect complete generated source first; reject original implementation import, unsafe side effects, and source retrieval; do not edit generated code
success_policy: One strict response; reviewed unchanged code; correct edited and preserved structure/resource/mutation; complete state mapping; non-empty exactly predeclared cases; candidate close to edited reference; detectable edited-reference versus original difference; no unexpected mutations

edit_observability.criterion: At least one predeclared input has edited-reference versus original difference greater than configured assert_close tolerance; negative output coordinates must also be observable for the negative witness.

baseline_comparison: difference is expected; never demand equality of original baseline and edited computation
